title: First session
body:
The first thing this program has to do: open an ACP session with an agent,
send a prompt, and show what comes back, in a terminal, readably. The agent
during development is a fake one in this repository that replays a scripted
session, because no real ACP agent is installed here and because every later
test needs a scripted agent anyway.

The code today is `cargo init`'s hello world.

## Pieces

| Issue | Role |
|---|---|
| fake agent | an ACP agent binary that replays a scenario file |
| session model | the transcript as data, built from ACP updates, with no screen |
| screen | ratatui rendering of the transcript and an input line |
| prompt loop | keys to prompt, prompt to agent, updates to model, model to screen |

They belong together because none can be shown working without the others,
and the fake agent is the oracle for all of them.

## Out of scope

- A real agent. Claude Code's ACP adapter needs node, which is not
  installed; that is a later session with Jack.
- Any decade wiring. The socket does not exist yet; see decade's milestone
  "Agent channel".
- Visual design beyond readable. Jack has strong views on how a chat
  should look, which is the reason this program exists, and the screen
  module is where they land once the data flows.
close_reason: All four pieces landed in one commit on 2026-11-06. A session opens, a prompt goes out, the reply streams in and is readable. Next milestones are the screen's design, which is Jack's, and a real agent once node and the Claude Code ACP adapter are installed.
